title: The controls a generation actually used
description: UMBRELLA created by the consolidation sweep, 2026-08-14. Members: MPI-556 (the sidecar records the PROJECT controls, not the runs - so Reuse restores a lie) and MPI-547 (named-parameter layer on generation.submit for agent generations). MPI-547 is BLOCKED BY MPI-556 on both cards: raw injectionParams always wins over resolved values, so any named-parameter layer inherits the gap and ships generations that cannot be reused. Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-561/plan.md.
